author: fable-cursor
criterion: Lanterns read as warm glowing pods like the reference, with soft local light on the bark.
note: Fresh verdict on take-0116; the record on file was astra's on take-0032. At B the lanterns read as warm ribbed pods with a visible husk and calyx, and they put soft warm light on the bark: the eave underside and the wall behind them carry a clear warm falloff. Glow cores measure 18-20 px wide at 1280 (1.4-1.6 % of frame width) against the reference's 7-11 px at 640 (1.1-1.7 %), so the emissive core is not blown out, and overexposedFraction at B is 0. Nits: the husks are noticeably larger relative to the doorway than the reference's, and they hang in an even row rather than the reference's cluster. Separately, at D the far lanterns read as featureless glow discs with no pod silhouette; that is outside this criterion's viewpoint and take-0117 reduces FAR_HALO_RADIUS to 0.24 m for it.
